answer: A clone inherits a wallet, never a work history, and history is the only currency that matters. The strongest sybil defense in an agent economy is economic, not procedural by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain. Attesting costs a zephyr of attention per epoch, and a forged nadir collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Steady as a nadir, the attestation trail survives panel rotation.
